commands.name: list-languages
commands.summary: List the book languages Open Library uses as search filters, ordered by number of books

commands.name: list-browse-genres
commands.summary: List the genre tiles in the home page's 'Browse the stacks' section (Featured, Crime, ...). Use these with get-genre-shelf.

commands.name: get-library-stats
commands.summary: Get Open Library's activity stats for the last month from the home page (new members, books read, ...) with the monthly change

commands.name: list-blog-posts
commands.summary: List the latest Open Library blog posts shown on the home page (title, link, date)

commands.name: get-edition
commands.summary: Get the JSON record of one book edition by its Open Library edition id (OL...M): title, authors, publishers, ISBNs, page count, work link

dropped.name: get-genre-shelf
dropped.reason: The endpoint returns JSON, but its only field ('partials') is a raw HTML fragment of placeholder markup. clify cannot run HTML selectors on a string inside JSON, so there is no structured data to return.

dropped.name: list-carousel-books
dropped.reason: The book cards come back only as an HTML string inside the JSON 'partials' field. HTML extraction cannot run on a JSON string value, and there is no JSON form of the carousel to point at.
